job.title: Software Development Engineer
job.pay_full: $101,500 – $145,000 a year base salary (excludes commission, bonus, equity and benefits)

details.about: Zscaler's Zero Trust Exchange is a cloud security platform that protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss, running across more than 200 public data centers and thousands of private edge sites. This hybrid Santa Clara role is on the Data & APIs team, which builds large-scale data pipelines and real-time streaming systems for Zscaler's security telemetry and the APIs that expose it. You report to the Sr Manager, Software Development Engineering, and own features end to end.
duties: Build and maintain backend services and REST/gRPC APIs that expose Zscaler's security data to internal teams and customers
Contribute to large-scale streaming and batch pipelines (Kafka, Spark/Flink) and the SQL, NoSQL and columnar storage behind them
Write and review design docs and contribute to AI/ML-enabled anomaly-detection and signal-correlation logic over streaming telemetry
Instrument, monitor and operate your services, including on-call rotation and incident response
Find pain points such as bugs, slow queries and flaky tests and ship improvements, working with senior engineers, Product and consuming teams
needs: Daily, hands-on use of modern AI coding assistants, code-review tools and agentic workflows
0–2 years of professional software engineering building backend services, with Java, Python or Go
Hands-on experience designing and building REST and/or gRPC APIs, including schema definition, versioning and auth
Working experience with streaming/batch data technologies (Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow or equivalent) and relational and/or NoSQL databases, including basic pipeline performance analysis
Exposure to Azure and/or GCP and to Docker/Kubernetes, with basic observability and debugging skills
Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms and distributed systems, and a track record of shipping production features end to end
nice: Using AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
Anomaly detection, signal triangulation or correlation over large-scale telemetry, logs or security/networking data
Azure or GCP managed streaming and data services, and warehouse/lakehouse tech such as Snowflake, Databricks, ClickHouse or Elasticsearch
API-first development: OpenAPI/protobuf, contract testing and API lifecycle management
details.benefits: Base pay range $101,500 – $145,000 a year, the new-hire target across all US locations; it excludes any commission, bonus or equity and benefits. Benefits include various health plans, vacation and sick time, parental leave options, retirement options, education reimbursement and in-office perks.
notes: Hybrid role in Santa Clara, CA
Zscaler offers accommodations in its recruiting process
